description: This file contains Sass mixins and functions related to Bootstrap, including utilities for evaluating source code (like checking map ordering and color contrast), string replacement, and theme color retrieval. It appears to be a partial SCSS source file defining styling functions for Bootstrap.

methods.name: _assert-ascending
methods.description: Mixin to verify that a Sass map contains values in ascending order, with warnings if not.

methods.name: _assert-starts-at-zero
methods.description: Mixin to verify that the first value of a breakpoint map is zero; warns if not.

methods.name: str-replace
methods.description: Function to replace substrings within a string, used for manipulating SVG icon background URLs.

methods.name: color-yiq
methods.description: Function to determine if a color is light or dark based on YIQ color space for contrast purposes.

methods.name: color
methods.description: Function to get a color from the $colors map by key.

methods.name: theme-color
methods.description: Function to get a theme color from the $theme-colors map by key.

methods.name: gray
methods.description: Function to get a gray shade from the $grays map by key.
